svg.title: Login: checks beyond valid credentials
svg.desc: An enabled challenge is consumed once for its operation, even when the password is wrong. Valid credentials and account state precede effective authorization and shared terminal/session-limit checks. Tokens and user data do not grant access to every resource.
svg.metadata: flowchart TB A["Validate login input and trusted request context"] B["Apply configured challenge and protection policies"] C["Verify credentials and account availability"] D["Resolve effective roles/permissions; check session policy"] E["Commit the shared session; issue tokens"] F["Return user and credentials; authorize business resources separately"] X["Return a domain failure; do not claim login success"] A --> B B --> C C --> D D --> E E --> F B -->|"challenge / policy rejection"| X C -->|"credential / account failure"| X E -->|"persistence failure"| X classDef default fill:#edf3ff,stroke:#476aab,color:#172b4d,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef good fill:#e9f6ef,stroke:#28734e,color:#17452f,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef stop fill:#fff0f0,stroke:#af4040,color:#742b2b,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef pending fill:#fff6df,stroke:#a07827,color:#654b18,stroke-width:1.5px; class F good; class X stop;

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC,Noto Sans CJK JP,sans-serif
